draft.main_summary:
### Features
- "Couldn't load UAT state. It needs a migrated database." On UAT page: Legacy UAT databases now migrate automatically so the UAT page can load state. (#374, PR #375)
- capture modal: allow direct paste of screenshot from clipboard: Refactored console.js attach upload into shared uploadAttachment() function and added clipboard paste support on the capture modal (Cmd+V/Ctrl+V uploads screenshots directly, derives filename from MIME type, last image wins, button shows filename+✓, reused by file picker unchanged) (#379, PR #380)
- needs you items shoudl include links to GH, and allow me to expand for more: Added expandable GitHub issue details and tappable answer choices to needs-you cards on phone and desktop. (#378, PR #381)
- Use second ChatGPT Work account before Claude: Added explicit dual ChatGPT Work account routing with Claude last and account-qualified Codex variants (#383, PR #384)
- Capture page doesn't clear previously selected attachment: Capture now clears previously selected attachments after saving. (#386, PR #390)
- Onboard movebreak to Mahler: Documented MoveBreak’s Mahler configuration and onboarding rollout status (#389, PR #391)
- Roll up shared capacity pools and section capability view by route size: Capacity quota pools and route-size capability sections (#403, PR #404)
- Estimate composite available quota by capability route size: Added approximate available quota slot counts to capability section headers, with coverage for mixed windows, shared pools, and unavailable routes. (#405, PR #406)
- Set reasoning effort per platform and record it on each run: reasoning effort is configurable per platform and recorded on every run (#415, PR #427)
- Record model, tokens and API-equivalent cost on every run, and backfill history: Run model, token and API-equivalent cost accounting with history backfill verified; after merge, run `mahler backfill-usage` once. (#416, PR #432)
- Named routing groups (@group) so each route is defined once: Added nested @group routing, deduplication, warnings, priority validation, console token preservation, and configuration examples. (#419, PR #445)
- Classify each run attempt as first-try success, failure, excluded or pending: Added on-demand attempt classification with late defect evidence, durable review/revert events, and synthetic-ledger tests. (#417, PR #439)
- When hot hold is shown due to a recent interactive session, tapping it should: Added End session buttons to hot-hold banners and idle reasons; holds lift immediately and return when new activity resumes. (#442, PR #458)
- On the browse page, hide the item text behind an expand icon. And for ones like: Verified and pushed browse quota expansion with stacked, labeled windows; all 1,243 tests passed. (#436, PR #447)
- Model scorecard: cost per success by role, size and variant (CLI, console, digest): Verified and pushed replayed scorecard work at 0302bb8; all 1,247 tests pass in normal and randomized order (seed 418). (#418, PR #467)
- On Capacity page, highlight models actively in use.: Capacity highlights active models and quota pools with accent borders and “in use” indicators. (#451, PR #468)
- Platform variants: several model × effort options per login, sharing its run slot (#420, PR #446)
- Pin exact model versions; the platform audit proposes new models as candidates: — pinned exact Claude model IDs (haiku-4-5-20251001, sonnet-5, opus-5-5 with opus-5 kept as a variant candidate) plus price rows; added a read-only "Model candidates" section to the platform audit (unpinned run models, unpriced pins, dominated variants, opt-in CLI list) with `Ledger.platform_models`/`models_with_cli_cost`. (#421, PR #480)
- Add GPT-6, Opus 5.5 and effort-level candidate variants (incumbents first): Added model candidate variants and verification documentation (#422, PR #481)
- Review loop: escalate to needs-you when successive review findings don't converge: Verified and pushed existing review-loop escalation work for non-converging findings. (#474, PR #491)
- Exploration: send a share of eligible items to unproven variants: Verified and pushed the existing unproven-variant exploration implementation. (#423, PR #496)
- Measured routing mode: route each role to the cheapest proven variant: Verified and pushed measured role routing; all 1,388 tests pass. (#424, PR #501)
- serve: timestamped request log with method, path, status, size and duration: Added timestamped request logs with method, path, status, response size, duration, and POST start markers before lock waits. (#505, PR #512)
- serve: log console_slow_request event for lock-wait or action over ~3s threshold: Added exception-safe slow console request telemetry with configurable threshold and full test coverage. (#506, PR #513)
- serve+console: POST /api/client_log endpoint and console.js error capture: Added authenticated, rate-limited client error logging with redaction and non-blocking console error reports. (#507, PR #514)
- cli+console: mahler events subcommand and Recent problems view: Added events CLI filtering and bounded desktop Recent problems view. (#508, PR #515)
- Console: batch Ready to test into test sessions with Pass all: Grouped Ready to test into sessions of up to 10 changes with shared staging links and two-tap Pass all that preserves failed and queued verdicts. (#504, PR #516)
- D33: measured routing ranks within free-first precedence, never across it: measured routing and exploration now rank within free-first cost classes while preserving Claude burst promotion (#522, PR #525)
- Console UAT Fail files bugs in the #292 shape (title/body contract): Console UAT failures now file bugs in the #292 title/body format (#524, PR #529)
- Console: weekly view of when each account's quota resets: Added responsive weekly quota reset schedules to Capacity and phone Browse. (#534, PR #545)

### Fixes
- "Cut release · phish-in" modal suggests v0.1 but obviously couch tour builds: Release proposals now follow each project's existing build version sequence and preserve two-part versions end-to-end. (#377, PR #382)
- Launch-failure circuit breaker: a code bug that fails every launch must page and stop retrying: Added persistent launch-failure circuit breakers, deduplicated alerts, 30-minute canaries, recovery notifications, console holds, and real SQLite-row launch tests. (#411, PR #412)
- Self-update: roll back to the last version that launched a run, and don't re-update into a rolled-back commit: Added launch-proven rollback and blocked re-updates to rejected commits; the launcher changed: re-run `launcher/install.sh` after merge. (#425, PR #428)
- Free builders: fix the Cline resume nudge (0 for 11, and it drops the push fence), add resume on network drops and for Kilo: Free builders: fix Cline resume nudge, add resume on network drops and for Kilo (#426, PR #431)
- Launch failures leak worktrees, and the janitor can't see them (about 7,300 leaked in the outage): Failed-launch worktrees and run branches are cleaned safely; janitor now removes stale launch leaks. (#434, PR #444)
- Escalation deadlock: a failed review escalates to a tier no route can serve, freezing the project's only slot (uses the reviewer's tier, uncapped): Escalation now uses builder tiers and route caps; waiting fixes release capacity and time out to needs-you. (#449, PR #455)
- Platform audit drops a renamed platform's run history: Platform audits now report historical outcomes for renamed, removed, and disabled slots without changing tier comparisons. (#435, PR #461)
- Console says 'CI has been pending' when the item is really waiting on a failed review / fix platform: Console accurately reports verification wait reasons and timing (#450, PR #463)
- Console: answering a parked (failed) item only posts a comment — it should also resume it: Failed console answers now resume parked items and preserve existing command behavior (#452, PR #465)
- False 'PR nobody is shipping' ping after a rebuild-on-base drops the item's PR link: Prevented false PR nobody-is-shipping pings during base rebuilds (#454, PR #466)
- Conductor marks an item done when its PR was closed without merging: Closed unmerged PRs now recover safely, preserving leases and adopting replacement PR branches correctly (#440, PR #457)
- Fix-run announcements say "CI was red" when the trigger was a failed review: Fix-run announcements distinguish failed reviews from red CI and reference review comments on the PR. (#473, PR #476)
- test_codex_quota flakes under load: success-path probes share the 0.5 s timeout: Short probe deadline only for stalling modes; success paths get 10 s (#478, PR #479)
- Hot Hold "End Session" but has no visible effect. Bug. p2.: Verified and pushed End Session feedback and non-blocking console reload notice implementation. (#464, PR #470)
- An item waiting on the conductor holds the project's only slot for hours: Idle conductor leases release run capacity; merges are serialized per project per tick, and slot blockers identify the executing run. (#486, PR #494)
- Console: a hung capture submit leaves the button stuck and the modal open, with no feedback or timeout: Added resilient capture timeouts, draft preservation, success feedback, and idempotent retries. (#502, PR #511)
- Out-of-credit errors (Cline 'Insufficient balance'): back off and resume automatically, ping if it lasts a day: Implemented automatic credit exhaustion backoff, recovery, alerts, and accounting. (#523, PR #526)

### Other changes
- Normalize Codex and Claude account slot naming and tiers: Normalized Codex and Claude capability slot naming, tiers, quota sharing, configuration examples, and documentation. (#398, PR #400)
- Capacity views for quota groups and capability slots: Capacity quota/capability toggle and work-copilot rename (#401, PR #402)
- Janitor: fast-forward each project's primary checkout when it is clean and behind: Janitor safely fast-forwards clean primary checkouts when behind. (#448, PR #462)
- backfill-usage: re-price runs stamped cost_source='unpriced' once a price exists (#484, PR #485)
- Console: backlog List/Graph toggle buttons do nothing: Backlog List/Graph toggle: CSS matched a nonexistent #mahler; now keys on :root with a slugged attribute name (#487, PR #488)
- Console hangs ('Page Unresponsive'): Models scorecard renders every run outcome, fragment is 2.7 MB: Capped Models outcomes at 20 recent runs per row, preserved full aggregates, and skipped unchanged refreshes with regression coverage. (#483, PR #493)
- Drop the Opus 5 candidate variant from claude-opus: Dropped the `claude-opus-5` candidate variant from `claude-opus` — removed it from `variants` in `mahler/config.py`, the stale price row, `config.example.toml`, `DESIGN.md`, and updated `tests/test_config.py` / `tests/test_routing.py` to expect only the three 5.5 effort levels. (#489, PR #495)
- Console: render the backlog Graph view with Mermaid (lazy-loaded, SVG fallback): Added lazy-loaded Mermaid backlog graphs with nested trackers, dependency arrows, refresh caching, and SVG fallback. (#490, PR #498)
- Console hangs when left open: render only the active view/layout instead of all 18 sections: Render only the active view/layout and requested overlays, preserve drafts, and report long tasks; responsive layout parameter retained without a separate /m path. (#521, PR #527)
- Console pages take ~1s each: scorecard rescans all history per request; build only the active view, trim Now (#532, PR #537)
- Back up Mahler's own ledger (mahler.db) nightly with integrity check, pruning and optional off-disk copy: Verified and pushed the replayed ledger backup implementation; all 1,491 tests pass. (#533, PR #549)
- Burst: a personal Claude chat shouldn't cancel work Claude's burst, and a burst run shouldn't be killed when the burst ends: Scoped Claude presence to its login and preserved burst launch limits for running jobs while retaining quota and overage stops. (#544, PR #550)
- Cline: pin the free model instead of inheriting Cline's saved default; add `mahler unhold <platform>`: pinned Cline’s free model and added tested CLI/console platform unhold support (#555, PR #556)

draft.maintenance_details:
<details>
<summary>Maintenance details (14)</summary>

- Require an adversarial/verifier review pass before Mahler merges an issue PR: Documented the required independent adversarial-review step (via /code-review, always covering lib/domain/*, auth, and security surfaces) between CI-green and merge in CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md. (#147, PR #148)
- Add continuous AI-code security scanning to CI (secrets, SAST, dependency integrity): Added `scripts/check-deps.ts` (dependency integrity gate, tested, wired into CI) and fixed a real bug in the prior run's `.gitleaks.toml` (empty allowlist block that would have failed every CI run at config-load), plus documented the security gate in `docs/OPERATIONS.md`/`docs/DECISIONS.md` and posted evidence (secret-detection proof, history scan result) as an issue comment. (#146, PR #154)
- Docs: CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/OPERATIONS.md drifted — repo layout, missing scripts, pnpm e2e:isolated: Fixed CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/docs/OPERATIONS.md drift (repo layout, 13 Commands scripts, exercise count 106, status date), documented `pnpm e2e:isolated`, updated TASKS.md's Context section, added `tests/docs-repo-layout.test.ts` regression test; typecheck/lint/test all green, pushed. (#152, PR #155)
- Docs: ARCHITECTURE §7/§8 describe API routes and an offline design that were never built: Update ARCHITECTURE.md §1, §3, §7, §8 to match shipped routes, offline model, and seeded rules, guarded by tests (#150, PR #158)
- Docs: README onboarding is broken — .env.local never loaded, script table and prereqs stale: Fixed README onboarding (.env not .env.local, full env var list required/optional, all 13 scripts in the table, Node 22/pnpm 10 prereqs from CI, local-Postgres note) and added tests/docs-readme-accuracy.test.ts to guard against drift. (#149, PR #159)
- Docs: ROADMAP/CHANGELOG/PRD — mark Phase 7 shipped, separate requirements from shipped behavior: Marked Phase 7 shipped, clarified PRD shipped-vs-unshipped requirements, and added tests/docs-links.test.ts regression tests. (#151, PR #160)
- Health: CLI scripts never close the pg pool, and the pool cache ignores its connection string: Keyed the pg pool cache by connection string, added `closeDb()`, made `runAtomic()` use the db handle's connection string via a WeakMap, made `isNeonDatabase` module-private, wrapped migrate/seed/uat-status CLI scripts in try/finally to close pools, and added tests/db-client-lifecycle.test.ts. (#162, PR #165)
- Health: delete orphaned exports and add a guard so dead code in lib/ cannot come back: Deleted orphaned exports and added unused value exports guard with empty allowlist in tests/no-unused-exports.test.ts (#163, PR #166)
- Health: break up generateSession() — 722 lines and ~143 branch points in one function: refactor generateSession into 6 pure step functions under 80 lines and add unit tests for each step (#164, PR #167)
- docs(architecture): §2 schema drift from lib/db/schema.ts, plus a guard test: Verified and pushed prior run's fix: reconciled docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §2 with lib/db/schema.ts (added `uat_results.github_issue_number`, updated migration count to 13, resolved the "Needs a human to check" items), plus a new guard test asserting doc/schema drift is caught automatically. (#169, PR #174)
- docs(architecture): §4/§5 domain signatures no longer match lib/domain, plus a guard test: aligned ARCHITECTURE §4/§5/§6 signatures with lib/domain and added bidirectional domain guard test (#170, PR #175)
- chore: delete committed agent scratch files (comment.md, issues.json) and gitignore them: delete committed agent scratch files (comment.md, issues.json), gitignore them, and add regression guard test (#172, PR #176)
- test(e2e): e2e/phase1 is excluded from the gating Playwright run — five specs never execute: Fixed a React-StrictMode double-session-creation race in e2e/persistence.spec.ts and e2e/visual-only.spec.ts (wait for network idle + session URL before interacting) that was flaking CI's now-gating phase1 specs; all "Done when" items were already satisfied by prior commits and verified locally at CI's exact worker count (4/4 green runs). Pre-existing e2e/phase3/warning-override.spec.ts has the same latent race but is out of this issue's scope — flagged for a follow-up issue. (#171, PR #173)
- test: a1-typecheck.test.ts re-runs tsc, costing 5.9s of a 14s suite: Replaced tsc subprocess in a1-typecheck.test.ts with CI workflow assertion, reducing test suite time by ~7.4s (#181, PR #182)
</details>

- Narrow the extension's permission surface and drop the unused node-cron dependency: Narrowed yahoo-sync manifest permissions/content-script matches to fantasy.espn.com + *.fantasysports.yahoo.com + localhost:3333, added URL validation with loopback warning in background.js/popup.js, removed unused node-cron dependency, added security-boundaries notes to README/AGENTS.md, and extended test_sync.js with a manifest scope assertion — npm test passes. (#20, PR #24)
- Server: bind to loopback, scope CORS to the draft origins, check WebSocket origin: Bound server to loopback by default, scoped CORS to draft origins, and enforced WebSocket origin checks. (#17, PR #25)
- Bound and validate every API request field before it reaches draft state: Bound and validated every API request field, capped request bodies to 64kb, and limited pickHistory to 2000 entries. (#19, PR #26)
- Decompose evaluateBoard() into named phases without changing its output: Decomposed evaluateBoard into named phases with identical output and golden-snapshot test coverage (#32, PR #34)
- Delete the duplicate public/draft_data.json board copy: Deleted duplicate public/draft_data.json, updated ingest script and docs, and added test guard against re-addition (#31, PR #35)
- Collapse the three duplicated draft-page bookmarklet scanners into one served source: Collapsed duplicated draft-page bookmarklet scanners into public/js/bookmarklet.js, deleted yahoo-sync duplicates, updated tests and docs (#30, PR #36)
- Server: crash-proof WebSocket handling, dead-client reaping, atomic state writes, clean shutdown: Server WebSocket error handling, ping/pong reaping, atomic saveState, and graceful shutdown implemented and verified (#29, PR #37)
- Docs: make README and AGENTS.md match the shipped surface, and guard it with a test: Aligned README.md and AGENTS.md with shipped endpoints, tests, and env vars, and added test/test_docs.js guard. (#39, PR #42)
- Extension: drop the redundant Yahoo host pattern and pin the manifest boundary in tests: Removed the redundant `draft.fantasysports.yahoo.com` entry from `yahoo-sync/manifest.json`'s `host_permissions`/`matches`, pinned the exact host boundary with deep-equal assertions in `test/test_sync.js`, and fixed the contradictory README.md:155 passage to match AGENTS.md's documented boundary. (#41, PR #43)
- Engine: retire pre-C/F roster defaults, fix the misplaced curve comment, cover the info banner and the three untested exports: Added direct unit test coverage for computeDynamicCliffs, computeTargetTradeoffs, getTopMatchup, and the no-rosterCounts/no-rosterLimits evaluateBoard FLEX-path default, completing the fallback-default/comment/banner fixes already committed in a prior run; full suite and mock-draft regression check pass. (#40, PR #44)
- test_server.js / test_gametheory.js: no silently-skipped assertions, no port race: test_server.js and test_gametheory.js eliminate silent assertion skips, retry port conflicts on EADDRINUSE, and poll observable state (#49, PR #50)
- test_app.js: unskippable XSS assertions and condition waits instead of fixed sleeps: test_app.js: replaced fixed sleeps with condition waits, made XSS assertions unskippable, removed process.exit(0), and cut runtime from 4.8s to 1.1s (#48, PR #51)
- test_sync.js: replace 17s of fixed sleeps with condition waits, close the leaked jsdom window: Replaced 17s of fixed sleeps in test_sync.js with condition waits, closed leaked jsdom window, and added scan interval seam (#47, PR #52)
- Test runner: per-file timing, per-file timeout, and no fail-fast: Added sequential test runner with per-file timing, timeouts, slow budgeting, and summary reporting (#46, PR #53)
- Server: memoize the per-pick board evaluation, index the name lookup, and stop re-shipping the 210 KB board: Memoized per-pick board evaluation, indexed player lookups in a prebuilt Map, enabled ETag/304 caching for draft_data.json, and compacted state file writes. (#56, PR #58)
- Extension: coalesce the double draft-page scan loop and stop the idle 5s full-state health poll: Coalesced draft-page scanning to debounced observer with heartbeat floor, gated background health checks on open draft tabs, and omitted currentPick from content script fan-out. (#55, PR #59)
- App: debounce the search-driven board rebuild, batch row attachment, and index the sidebar's pick lookup: Debounced search input on trailing timer with window seam, batched board row attachments via DocumentFragment, and indexed sidebar pick lookup via Map memoized on evaluation state. (#57, PR #60)
</details>
